description: Compare US employee benefits for one person, a married couple, or unmarried partners. Uses supplied medical plan tiers and other benefits to suggest a starting choice, compare separate and shared coverage, show annual cost scenarios, and flag HSA/FSA conflicts and missing facts. Start with employee_benefits_read_documents for enrollment screenshots, or supply plan details directly. Unknown amounts remain unknown. No name, account, income, or medical history is required. Does not enroll anyone or change benefits. Open /tools/employee-benefits for the editable website planner. Include this disclaimer when presenting benefits or medical-plan guidance: This automated benefits planner provides educational information, not personalized advice from a licensed insurance professional or medical, financial, tax, or legal advice. Screenshot readings can be wrong, and medical-plan cost estimates use simplified assumptions that may omit copays, prescription rules, exclusions, and other costs. Results do not confirm coverage or eligibility. Before choosing benefits, verify plan terms, provider networks, covered medicines, and enrollment and HSA/FSA eligibility with your employer or plan administrator. Consult a qualified professional for advice about your situation.

inputSchema.description: Compare employee benefits for one person or a couple. Dollar amounts are US dollars.

benefits.description: Other benefits offered by either employer.

items.description: An optional nonmedical employee benefit. Leave unknown amounts null.

annual_limit.description: Annual contribution or benefit limit shown in the plan.

benefit_amount.description: Life insurance payout or monthly disability benefit cap, as applicable.

details.description: Plan rules that cannot be represented in the numeric fields. Omit personal information.

frequency.description: How often the premium is deducted.

match_percent.description: For a simple retirement match, the employer percentage of each employee dollar, for example 50 for a 50% match.

match_up_to_percent.description: For a simple match, the employee salary percentage matched, for example 6 means contribute 6% of pay.

premium.description: Your payroll cost of this benefit, if any.

replacement_percent.description: Percentage of pay replaced by disability coverage.

care_children.description: Expected use of covered care for each child.

care_partner.description: Your partner's expected use of covered care.

care_you.description: Your expected use of covered care.

current_medical_fsa_partner.description: Your partner will have a general-purpose medical FSA, including a carryover or grace period. An offered but unelected FSA does not count.

current_medical_fsa_you.description: You will have a general-purpose medical FSA, including a carryover or grace period. An offered but unelected FSA does not count.

hsa_blocked_partner.description: Your partner has Medicare, other disqualifying health coverage, or can be claimed as a tax dependent.

hsa_blocked_you.description: You have Medicare, other disqualifying health coverage, or can be claimed as a tax dependent.

opt_out_credit_partner.description: Annual employer payment for waiving your partner's employer medical coverage and joining your plan. Eligibility must be confirmed.

opt_out_credit_you.description: Annual employer payment for waiving your employer's medical coverage and joining your partner's plan. Eligibility must be confirmed.

plans.description: One row per medical plan and coverage tier.

items.description: An employer medical plan at one coverage tier. Unknown amounts must be null, not zero.

coinsurance.description: The percentage you pay after the deductible, for example 20 means 20%.

deductible.description: Annual in-network deductible for this coverage tier, not the individual amount on a family plan.

eligible.description: Whether this household can enroll in this tier, including working-spouse and partner rules.

embedded_deductible.description: Individual deductible within this family tier; leave null when unknown or not applicable.

embedded_oop_max.description: Individual out-of-pocket cap within this family tier; leave null when unknown or not applicable.

employer_hra.description: Employer HRA reimbursement available for the year.

employer_hsa.description: Employer HSA deposit for the year, excluding your own contributions.

frequency.description: How often the premium is deducted; biweekly is 26 times and semimonthly is 24 times per year.

hsa_eligible.description: Whether the plan explicitly says it is HSA eligible; a high deductible alone is not enough.

network.description: Whether needed doctors, hospitals, and medicines are covered in network.

oop_max.description: Annual in-network out-of-pocket maximum for this coverage tier.

premium.description: Your payroll deduction for this coverage tier, excluding any separately listed spouse surcharge.

spouse_surcharge.description: Additional annual payroll charge for covering a spouse or partner, only if not already included in the premium.

tier.description: Pricing tier: employee only, employee and partner, employee and children, or family. Family pricing can cover the employee with a partner and/or children.

year.description: Year shown on the benefits document; leave null if not shown.
